# Security & Copyright Enforcement Policy

## Reporting Intellectual Property Infringements & Vulnerabilities

MediaSphere AI is proprietary commercial software owned exclusively by Pushkar ([@pushka2006](https://github.com/pushka2006)).

### 1. Copyright Infringement & Unauthorized Clones
If you detect an unauthorized clone, distribution, commercial deployment, or tampered version of this repository:
- Report directly to the repository owner via GitHub: [@pushka2006](https://github.com/pushka2006)
- Unauthorized usage incurs a mandatory **$1,000 USD liquidated damages fine** (payable within 30 days) and criminal charges upon non-compliance under 17 U.S.C. § 506 and Indian Copyright Act 1957 Section 63.

### 2. Software Integrity
Tampering with or removing licensing files, headers, or runtime verification guards is strictly prohibited and monitored.
